pr_title: Fix outdated api url in noaa_tides
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
The external web service used by the noaa_tides platform moved its
api to a new url. The pypi package used to fetch data (py_noaa) still 
points to the old/broken url. It is outdated and has been 
replaced - no further development is planned.

I've updated the sensor to use the replacement package 
(noaa-coops==0.1.8). The new package uses a Station class to fetch 
tide data so I changed setup_platform to create a station instance 
and changed the sensor's update function to use the station class 
to get data.

- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): ubuntu 18.02/python 3.7 venv
- Integration causing this issue: noaa
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/noaa_tides/

## Additional information
comments:
There appears to be an outage or change to noaa's mdapi. There is an issue tracking it in the noaa library used in this integration
 GClunies/py_noaa#40

Experiencing same issue.   Strangely if I hit https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/datagetter?begin_date=20200826+20%3A48&end_date=20200828+20%3A48&station=9447130&product=predictions&datum=MLLW&interval=hilo&units=english&time_zone=lst_ldt&application=py_noaa&format=json from my computer I get nice JSON.   If I curl it from pi running home assistant I get 

```<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">
<title>Error</title>
</head>
<body>

Exception: possible bad request, please use https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api-helper/url-generator.html for help.



</body>
</html>
```

The URL of the NOAA api changed but I don't think GClunies/py_noaa#40 will be fixed. GClunies/py_noaa looks to be outdated and is replaced with GClunies/noaa_coops.

I have a small fix that uses the new noaa-coops package. I'm struggling a little with the development checklist (specifically the tox tests) but, when I figure it out, I'll submit a PR.

FYI...If you hit the url in a browser, it automatically redirects to the new url (https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/datagetter to https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter).

review_comments: You should raise `PlatformNotReady` if you are unable to setup.  If there was a momentary issue on connectivity, this will ensure that home assistant retries setup later.
Thanks for the tip. I think it is a better idea to catch exceptions in the line above and just get rid of this altogether. I'll raise `PlatformNotReady` there where appropriate.
